title: SAKU Data State Vocabulary Candidate
description: Use only where state distinctions carry semantic value; do not wrap every field.

x-saku-semantics.PRESENT: Value is explicitly present in the observed artifact.
x-saku-semantics.ABSENT: Field or declaration is absent; no configuration conclusion follows.
x-saku-semantics.UNKNOWN: Available evidence cannot resolve the state.
x-saku-semantics.NOT_CONFIGURED: The configuration owner authoritatively reports no configuration.
x-saku-semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The item does not apply under the identified semantic context.
x-saku-semantics.EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Resolution requires evidence owned outside this artifact.
